overall_assessment: Reviewed all 20 packet entries (14 suspects and 6 controls); JUR661 has a packet-builder cap on its full-plan text, which is not an extractor defect. The short/duplicate flags on four INTH offerings expose retained language placeholders, whereas the boilerplate flags on INF367/INF367A and NOSP216 mostly identify legitimate repeated outcomes, methods, requirement-validity rules, prerequisites and syllabus notes. Section boundaries and learning-outcome groups generally survive, but grading-scale loss is systematic across substantive suspects and controls, meaning-based routing remains incomplete, and one control retains assessment logistics.

findings.evidence:
Karakterskala
Ved sensur av mappe blir det brukt karakterskalaen A-F.
findings.description: The Karakterskala block maps to unmapped and is omitted from assessment. Four INF offerings, six NOSP216 offerings and four controls (ARK212, BIO399, NODI101 and HEFR331) lose substantive grading-scale information: 14/20 packet entries. The specification explicitly includes grading scale in assessment design. LOGO345 retains its scale only because its assessment paragraph repeats it; no inference is made about the capped portion of the JUR661 full plan. None of the pre-pass flags identifies this loss.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps English grading scale to assessment but lacks Karakterskala. In R/extract_sections.R, sectionize() closes the current section at an unmapped heading and discards its text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exact case-insensitive Karakterskala -> assessment mapping in R/section_heading_map.R, retaining its text alongside the other assessment blocks. Preserve the separate drop rule for Vurderingssemester.

findings.evidence: Informasjonen fins ikkje på norsk. Sjå dei engelske nettsidene.
findings.description: All four INTH offerings emit language-unavailability notices as content, outcomes, prerequisites, teaching methods, coursework requirements and reading lists; two also emit an assessment made entirely of such notices and an aids label. This explains the short/dup_in_course flags: the repeated source notices are placeholders, rather than duplicated substantive sections. The unflagged JUR661 control similarly emits a prerequisites row containing only a reference to other programme courses plus Not relevant., and a reading-list row saying only that the list will be ready before 1 July. These provide no actual prerequisite knowledge or literature. Genuine permitted-aids text in the 2023/2025 INTH assessments must survive removal of the notice.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The .placeholder_phrases patterns in R/extract_sections.R omit the UiB Nynorsk language notices, their TInformasjonen typo, Not relevant., the programme-course reference and the English reading-list availability notice. UiB also has no english_page fallback configuration, but missing English source text itself is upstream of this sections audit.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the anchored placeholder patterns to the observed UiB language notices (including the optional leading T and following Sjå dei engelske nettsidene.), Not relevant., the exact programme-course reference, and the reading-list availability notice. Filter placeholder blocks before merging canonical sections, then suppress rows with no substantive text; preserve Hjelpemiddel til eksamen followed by Ingen or actual aids.

findings.evidence: Masteroppgåva har to deler: ei innleiing (kappe) og eit artikkelmanus.
findings.description: Meaning-based section assignment is incomplete when source headings bundle several kinds of text. LOGO345 files the graded thesis structure under coursework_requirements, together with the genuine project-plan approval gate. INF367 in spring 2025 and autumn 2024 files the sentence about theoretical teaching and practical programming exercises under course_content; NOSP216 in 2022/2024 similarly files supervised corpus exercises, visits, interviews or workshops there. JUR661 also leaves its practical legal-adviser exercise description under course_content. The affected text describes assessment design or how students work, rather than subject matter or an ungraded exam-access gate. The repeated-text pre-pass does not detect this semantic misclassification.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map assigns whole Mål og innhold and Obligatorisk undervisningsaktivitet blocks to one section. sectionize() preserves those assignments, and current cleanup does not route these embedded teaching-method and thesis-design sentences by meaning.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrow sentence/block routing rules in R/extract_sections.R for the observed wording: move Masteroppgåva har to deler and its thesis-guidelines continuation from coursework_requirements to assessment while retaining Prosjektplan skal godkjennast as coursework. Move explicit teaching sentences beginning Det blir en kombinasjon av teoretisk undervisning and the observed corpus-practice/workshop passages from course_content to teaching_methods, preserving the source wording and existing method text.

findings.evidence: Oppgåver på 60 stp innleverast senast ein månad før slutten av det 4. semesteret (1. juni/15. november). Mal for oppgåva kommer på bioWRITE
findings.description: BIO399 assessment includes the Fristar block with submission timing, calendar deadlines and a template-location notice. It also retains the standalone sentence requiring the examiner and supervisor to attend the presentation. These are submission logistics, a document pointer and examiner arrangements, which the specification excludes from assessment sections. The thesis, public presentation, oral examination, grade adjustment and permitted-aids rules are legitimate assessment design and should remain. This defect occurs in a random control without a pre-pass flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fristar is not a section boundary in the packet heading list, so its text remains inside Vurderingsformer. UiB .section_noise patterns in R/extract_sections.R handle footer/widget text but not this embedded deadline/template block or standalone examiner-attendance sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiB-specific cleanup for the exact Fristar submission-deadline/template block and the standalone sentence Sensor og veileder skal være til stede ved den offentlige presentasjonen. Apply these only to section text, preserving the surrounding assessment-design sentences and the full course plan.
